## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender girl with glossy auburn or red hair, milk-white skin, and big, luminous gray-green eyes. She has a pointed face, a pretty nose, and long slender fingers, along with a few tiny freckles on her nose. She has previously worn her hair in long braids, shingled short, or styled in soft curls.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P55](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0055), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c27 P36](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0036), [v1 c28 P6](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0006), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P41](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0041), [v3 c9 P1](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0001), [v4 c1 P25](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0025), [v4 c12 P21](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0021), [v4 c20 P17](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0017), [v4 c30 P19](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0019)_

## Personality

Anne is intensely imaginative, romantic, and optimistic, often prone to vivid daydreams and high spirits. She possesses a passionate and impulsive nature, alongside a strong will and deep loyalty to her friends. Though she carried a fiery temper and held grudges in her youth, she is also highly earnest, ambitious, and understanding. She takes great joy in beauty and retains a playful, childish spirit even as she matures into adulthood.

## History

Born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia to high school teacher Walter Shirley and Bertha Shirley, Anne was orphaned as an infant. She spent a harsh childhood living with Mrs. Thomas, Mrs. Hammond, and at an orphan asylum before being brought to Green Gables by Matthew Cuthbert and Marilla Cuthbert. In Avonlea, she formed a lifelong friendship with Diana Barry and maintained an intense academic rivalry with Gilbert Blythe. After attending Queen's Academy and earning her teacher's license, she won the Avery Scholarship and later taught school in Avonlea, during which time she helped found the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. Anne proceeded to Redmond College, where she earned her B.A. degree and won the Thorburn Scholarship in English. Following three years of teaching school in Summerside, she married Gilbert Blythe and settled in Four Winds, eventually giving birth to a son, Little Jem.
